subject: WORLD_HISTORY
explanation: History is the study of the past: what people did, how they lived and how things changed.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: An object made and used by people long ago, such as an old clay pot, is called what?
explanation: An artifact is an object made by people in the past. Artifacts such as pots, tools and coins help us learn how people lived.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: A line that shows events in the order they happened is called a ___.
explanation: A timeline is a line marked with events in the order they happened, from earliest to latest.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: The Great Wall is a very long wall that was built long ago. In which country is it?
explanation: The Great Wall is in China. It was built and rebuilt over many hundreds of years.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: The Great Pyramid of Giza was built thousands of years ago as a tomb for a king. In which country is it?
explanation: The Great Pyramid of Giza is in Egypt. It was built about 4,500 years ago as a tomb for a king called a pharaoh.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: Why did many people long ago build their villages near rivers?
choices: To watch the fish swim and the boats go by
To build sandcastles on the sandy riverbanks
To have water for drinking and growing food
correctAnswer: To have water for drinking and growing food
explanation: People settled near rivers because they needed water to drink, to cook and to grow crops.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: Which would best help you learn what your grandfather's life was like when he was a child?
choices: Talking with him and looking at his old photographs
Reading a picture book about dinosaurs from long ago
Looking at tomorrow's weather report on television
correctAnswer: Talking with him and looking at his old photographs
explanation: Interviews and old photographs are sources that come from the person's own life, so they are the best way to learn about his childhood.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: Put these events in Maya's life in order from first to last.
explanation: A person is born first, learns to walk as a toddler, starts kindergarten at about age five and begins second grade about two years later.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: Which of these did people use 200 years ago? Select all that apply.
explanation: Two hundred years ago people used candles for light, horses for travel on land and sailing ships to cross the sea. Televisions and computers had not been invented.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: Diwali, Lunar New Year and Eid are all examples of what?
choices: Kinds of maps used by sailors long ago
Ancient buildings in Egypt and Greece
Types of boats used on rivers
explanation: Diwali, Lunar New Year and Eid are holidays. Families in many parts of the world celebrate them with food, gatherings and special traditions.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: Use the word bank: ancient, modern. Something from very long ago is ___. Something from today is ___.
explanation: Ancient means from a very long time ago. Modern means from the present time.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: Long ago in ancient Greece, athletes gathered for races and contests. Games with the same name are still held today. What are they called?
explanation: The Olympic Games began in ancient Greece more than 2,700 years ago. The modern Olympic Games are named after them.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: How is keeping food cold today different from 100 years ago?
passage: One hundred years ago, many homes had no electric refrigerator. A worker brought big blocks of ice to each house. Families put the ice in a wooden box called an icebox to keep food cold.
choices: Today nobody keeps food cold, so it is eaten right away
Most homes now use electric refrigerators, not ice
Today a worker brings blocks of ice to every house
Today food is kept cold in wooden boxes with no ice
correctAnswer: Most homes now use electric refrigerators, not ice
explanation: The passage explains that families used blocks of ice in an icebox. Today most homes use electric refrigerators instead.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: Two people saw the same parade long ago and wrote about it. Their stories are a little different. Why might that be?
choices: One of the two writers must not have been a real person
Parades did not exist long ago
Each person saw and remembered different things
Stories about the past are always made up
correctAnswer: Each person saw and remembered different things
explanation: People notice and remember different things, so two true accounts of the same event can be different. Historians compare accounts to learn more.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: Long ago, rulers in China had the Great Wall built. What is the most likely reason for building such a long wall?
choices: To make a road for cars
explanation: The Great Wall was built to help protect China's northern lands from attack. There were no cars long ago, and a wall cannot hold back the ocean.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: Put these in order from longest ago to most recent.
orderedItems: The pyramids are built in Egypt
explanation: The pyramids were built thousands of years ago. Your grandparents were born many years ago, and you were born most recently.

subject: WORLD_HISTORY
prompt: An old letter says at the top: "June 3, 1920, Paris." What does this tell you?
choices: When and where the letter was written
The name of the person who delivered the letter
correctAnswer: When and where the letter was written
explanation: The date tells when the letter was written and the city tells where. Historians look for this information on every source.
